## Why

The merged fork-token repair is present on current `main` at `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml:1206-1236`, and its focused regression coverage is in `tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py:260-359`. However, merged PR #75 / issue #74 did not preserve the required literal deliberate-break → restoration transcript in the squash diff. This follow-up records falsifiable evidence without changing the shipped Gate behavior.

## Scope

Capture a fresh deliberate-break replay against current `main`: temporarily replace only the production `readOnlyForkToken` condition in `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` with `false`, run the focused pytest file, restore the workflow exactly, rerun the same command, and commit the literal RED/GREEN transcript under `docs/evidence/`.

## Non-Goals

- Do not alter the fork-token tolerance behavior merged in PR #75.
- Do not change shared Workflows templates or unrelated Manager-Mosaic behavior.
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: a documentation file without a failing deliberate-break run and a passing restored run does not satisfy this issue.

## Tasks

- [ ] Run `python -m pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov` on the restored current `main` behavior and capture the baseline output.
- [ ] In `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml`, temporarily replace only the `readOnlyForkToken` condition at the status-reporting step with `false`; run `python -m pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov` and capture the literal failing output.
- [ ] Restore `.github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml` exactly, rerun the same pytest command, and add the RED/GREEN transcript to `docs/evidence/issue-76-gate-fork-deliberate-break.md`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] With only `readOnlyForkToken` forced to `false`, `python -m pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov` exits non-zero and reports failures in the fork/deleted-fork read-only-token cases; the literal output is captured in `docs/evidence/issue-76-gate-fork-deliberate-break.md`.
- [ ] After exact restoration, `python -m pytest tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py -q --no-cov` exits 0 with all focused tests passing; the literal output is captured in the same evidence file.
- [ ] `git diff --exit-code HEAD -- .github/workflows/pr-00-gate.yml tests/test_gate_commit_status_fork_tolerance.py` exits 0 before commit, proving the deliberate break was not shipped.

## Implementation Notes

This is an evidence-only follow-up for #74 and merged PR #75 (merge `46ee06cbac8a`). The closing PR should link #76 and distinguish the fresh current-main replay from historical evidence that was not captured.
title: [P2] D4 follow-up: deliberate-break transcript for merged PR #75 (#74)
